spec: Build a REST API for personal notes. Users can create, list, fetch, update and delete notes. Each note has a title, body and timestamps. Notes are stored in DynamoDB.

plan.summary: A REST API for managing personal notes, supporting create, list, fetch, update, and delete operations. Each note contains a title, body, and timestamps, and all notes are persisted in DynamoDB. Built with FastAPI for a clean JSON API interface.

endpoints.purpose: Create a new note with a title and body; sets created and updated timestamps.
Fetch a single note by its ID.
Update an existing note's title and/or body and refresh the updated timestamp.
Delete a note by its ID.

aws_resources.name: notes
aws_resources.justification: Primary storage for notes as required by the spec; stores each note keyed by note_id.

aws_resources.name: personal_notes_api_fn
aws_resources.justification: Hosts the FastAPI application to serve the REST endpoints in a serverless manner.

aws_resources.name: personal_notes_api_gw
aws_resources.justification: Exposes the Lambda-backed FastAPI application over HTTP for the CRUD endpoints.

aws_resources.name: personal_notes_api_role
aws_resources.justification: Grants the Lambda function permission to read/write the DynamoDB table and write logs.

aws_resources.name: personal_notes_api_logs
aws_resources.justification: Captures application and Lambda execution logs for observability and debugging.

assumptions: No authentication or per-user separation was specified; the API treats notes as a single shared collection (a 'user_id' scope could be added later).
Each note is identified by a server-generated UUID stored as note_id, the DynamoDB partition key.
Timestamps (created_at, updated_at) are generated server-side in ISO 8601 UTC format.
The API returns and accepts JSON, so FastAPI is used.
Listing notes uses a full table scan; pagination is not required given the personal-scale use case.
The application is deployed as a Lambda behind API Gateway, which is compatible with LocalStack Community Edition.

🐍 Generated application code (initial): 5 files — FastAPI personal notes REST API with a DynamoDB storage layer behind a small repository interface. 🏗️ Generated Terraform (initial): 4 files — Terraform for personal_notes_api mapping every plan aws_resource: a DynamoDB table (SSE with CMK + point-in-time recovery), a Lambda function packaged inline via local_file + archive_file (reserved concurrency, KMS-encrypted env vars, SQS DLQ), an API Gateway REST API with proxy integration/stage (access logging, X-Ray, method logging), a least-privilege IAM role/policy scoped to specific ARNs, and CloudWatch log groups (365-day retention, KMS-encrypted). A shared KMS key with rotation backs encryption. Provider pins hashicorp/aws ~>5.0 in versions.tf with default_tags. LocalStack-incompatible Checkov checks (X-Ray/VPC/code signing on Lambda, caching/WAF/authorizer on API Gateway) are handled with documented inline skips; all other best-practice checks are satisfied directly.
